basic_info.description: Welcome to 646-648 6th Avenue, a spacious 2,800 sq ft duplex in the Inner Richmond neighborhood. With a freshly painted exterior and freshly painted top floor interior, this home blends classic charm with modern comforts, featuring soaring ceilings, hardwood floors, and elegant period details. The top floor offers 3 bedrooms, a split bath, living room, and dining room which will be delivered vacant, allowing for owner occupancy and customization. The middle unit includes 2 bedrooms, living room, dining room, kitchen, and split bath providing immediate rental income. The ground floor features a spacious garage, two bonus rooms, a wet bar, an additional split bath, and a large backyard. With a Walk Score of 94, you're steps from shops, cafes, Safeway, Golden Gate Park, and public transit. Don't miss this rare opportunity offering character, income potential, and a prime location ideal for owner-occupants and investors alike.
